unsupported-provider: That is not an AI provider this app knows. Pick Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini, or connect a local runner by its address.
keychain-unavailable: Could not open this computer's keychain. Unlock it and try again.
keychain-write-failed: Could not save the key into the keychain. Unlock the keychain and save again.
keychain-clear-failed: Could not delete the key, so it may still be there. Unlock the keychain and try again, or delete the "Ontology Atlas" item yourself in Keychain Access.
secret-empty: The key box is empty. Paste the key, or press Clear if you meant to remove it.
secret-missing: No key is saved for this provider yet. Add one in Agents, then Models, first.
secret-has-newline: The saved key has a line break in it. Save it again without the line break.
jev-payload-invalid: The Jev request is invalid. Check the explanation and evidence, then try again.
jev-response-invalid: Jev returned an answer Atlas could not interpret. The transfer was recorded, but no judgment was accepted.
jev-http-failed: Jev could not complete the request. Check your key or credits and try again.
endpoint-too-long: That address is too long. Paste only the runner's address, up to 300 characters.
endpoint-invalid-characters: That address holds characters this app cannot send, such as a space, a quote, or a question mark. Paste only the address.
endpoint-scheme-unsupported: The address has to start with http:// or https://.
endpoint-host-missing: The address has no host in it. Something like http://localhost:11434 works.
endpoint-credentials-in-url: Do not put an id or a password in the address. It would stay in the local record exactly as written. Paste only the address.
endpoint-plaintext-blocked: Outside this computer only https:// is sent. Plain http:// works for localhost alone.
endpoint-not-for-key: Connecting by address does not use a key. Leave the key box empty.
endpoint-fixed-for-provider: This provider's address is fixed inside the app and cannot be changed. The key only ever travels to that address.
host-not-found: Could not find the host in that address. Check the address and try again.
connection-refused: Nothing answered at that address. The runner may be off, or the port may be different.
timed-out: The answer did not arrive in time. Try again, or check whether the model is still loading.
tls-failed: Could not make a secure connection. Check the address, and check whether something on the network is sitting in the middle.
no-response: No answer came back. Check the network and try again.
request-failed: This computer could not send the request. Try again.
model-invalid: That model name holds characters this app cannot send. Pick a name from the list.
audit-blocked: Nothing was sent, because the record of the call could not be written into the folder. Make sure the folder can be written to, then try again.
audit-vault-unreadable: Could not open the folder the call is recorded in. Choose the folder again.
audit-log-write-failed: Could not write the record of this call, so nothing was sent. Make sure the folder can be written to.
audit-log-busy: Another request for this same folder is finishing its record. Wait a moment and try again.
audit-log-unsupported: This computer's system cannot keep the call record safely yet, so nothing is sent. Recording works on macOS and Linux.
audit-log-tampered: The record file changed while it was being written, so the earlier records were kept and nothing was sent. Check whether another program is touching that file.
vault-path-empty: No folder was given. Open a folder first.
vault-path-missing: That folder is not there any more. It may have moved or been deleted. Open it again.
vault-path-not-a-folder: That path is a file, not a folder. Choose the folder that holds the notes.
vault-path-unresolvable: Could not settle where that folder really is. Check the folder's permissions and open it again.
git-not-runnable: Could not run git on this computer. Install git, then try again.
git-network-timeout: git did not finish in time. Check the remote address and your sign-in, then try again.
git-repo-missing: This folder is not keeping a history yet. Press Start history on the footprints screen.
git-status-failed: Could not read this folder's changes. Make sure the folder is still there, then try again.
git-init-repo-missing: The history started, but the repository could not be found again. Check the folder's permissions.
restore-untracked: This document has never been committed, so there is no earlier content to go back to. Delete the file yourself if you do not need it.
restore-source-missing: That commit does not contain this document. It may have been created later or had another name.
restore-identity-mismatch: The document's identity at that commit (uid, slug or merged_uids) differs from the current one, so nothing was restored: restoring as-is could break links from other documents. To bring back only the body, read that version and edit by hand.
restore-identity-check-failed: Could not read this document on disk, so the check that it is still the same document could not run. Nothing was restored. Check the file, then try again.
restore-path-invalid: This path does not point inside the folder, so nothing was touched.
restore-source-invalid: The commit reference is not valid, so nothing was restored.
git-restore-failed: Could not restore the document. It was not changed.
push-non-fast-forward: The remote moved ahead of you. Run git pull, then snapshot again.
gpg-sign-failed: Signing the commit failed. Check the signing key, or turn signing off with git config commit.gpgsign false.
merge-in-progress: A merge or rebase is still going, so only part of the folder cannot be committed. Finish or stop it first, then snapshot.
pull-conflict: Pulling ran into a conflict. Fix the conflicting files, then commit.
local-changes: There are changes here that were never saved, so this stopped instead of overwriting them. Snapshot them first.
no-upstream: This branch has no remote connected yet. Connect one first.
push-no-upstream: Nothing was sent, because this branch has no remote connected. Your saved steps are still on this computer.
push-detached-head: Nothing was sent, because a commit is checked out rather than a branch. Your saved steps are still on this computer.
remote-unreachable: Could not reach the remote repository. Check that the address is right and that you have access to it.
remote-auth: The remote turned down the sign-in. Check the credentials this computer is using.
pre-commit-hook: A commit hook stopped the snapshot. Fix what the hook reported, then snapshot again.
commit-rejected: The commit was turned down. A commit hook may have stopped it.
remote-url-empty: Type the repository address to send to.
remote-url-leading-dash: The address cannot start with a dash. Paste only the repository address.
remote-url-has-whitespace: The address has a space in it. Paste only the repository address.
remote-url-unrecognized: That does not look like a repository address. It looks like git@github.com:you/repo.git.
connector-secret-ref-invalid: That connector reference is not a shape this machine can store. Remove the connector and add it again.
connector-secret-missing: A token this connector needs is not in this machine’s keychain. Open Connectors, enter it again, or switch the connector off.
acp-line-rewrite-failed: The message to the agent could not be prepared. Try opening the conversation again.
